name: orc
description: Orchestrate AI coding sessions to build an app from one detailed plan.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.demo:status: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js status -c test/fixtures/demo/orc.config.json
scripts.demo:plan: npm run build && rm -rf .demo/plan && mkdir -p .demo && cp -R test/fixtures/planner .demo/plan && cd .demo/plan && node ../../dist/cli/index.js plan idea.md
